# ADR-0000: Decision Title

> **Status:** Proposed | Accepted | Superseded
> **Date:** YYYY-MM-DD
> **Owner:** role or name
> **Related documents:** links

---

## Context

Describe the problem, constraints, forces, and decision deadline.

## Decision

State the selected option clearly.

## Alternatives Considered

List meaningful alternatives and why they were not selected.

## Consequences

Describe expected benefits, tradeoffs, risks, and follow-up obligations.

## Validation

Describe how the decision will be verified or revisited.
